name: decodo
description: Scrape any web page as Markdown or a screenshot, search the web, and crawl or map entire sites with Decodo's Web Data API.

interface.shortDescription: Live web data for your chats
interface.longDescription: Scrape any web page as Markdown or a screenshot, search the web, and crawl or map an entire site to collect pages in bulk. Requests run through Decodo's Web Data API, which handles JavaScript rendering, proxy rotation and anti-bot systems, with geo-targeting across 195+ locations. Requires a Decodo account; each request uses your Web Data API plan.
capabilities: Take full-page screenshots of web pages
Crawl an entire website and collect its pages
Map the URLs a website exposes
defaultPrompt: Scrape decodo.com from a US IP and summarize the pricing.
Search the web for MCP server hosting options.

positive.prompt: Scrape https://decodo.com/scraping/web and list the plans it mentions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the page content as Markdown and lists the plans named on it.

positive.prompt: Search the web for MCP server hosting options.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranked web results with titles and links.

positive.description: Map the URLs on a site
positive.prompt: Map the URLs under help.decodo.com and group them by section.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the URLs the site exposes and groups them by section.

positive.prompt: Take a screenshot of github.com from a US IP address.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a PNG screenshot of the github.com home page.

positive.description: Crawl a site and summarize it
positive.prompt: Crawl https://decodo.com/blog and summarize what the most recent posts cover.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a crawl, polls it with crawl_status, reads the pages with crawl_results and summarizes them.

negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest wireless keyboard on Amazon for me.

negative.description: Signing in to third-party accounts is not supported
negative.prompt: Log in to my bank account and show my balance.
Post a comment on this YouTube video saying it was great.
